# Maxis Penthouse Bled

> A one-bedroom luxury penthouse apartment for up to two guests in central Bled, Slovenia, with a private balcony, mountain views, air conditioning, and free parking.

## Official website

- Homepage: https://maxisbled.com/
- Bled guide: https://maxisbled.com/bled-guide.html
- Sitemap: https://maxisbled.com/sitemap.xml

## Accommodation facts

- Name: Maxis Penthouse
- Type: One-bedroom penthouse apartment
- Location: Prešernova cesta 15, 4260 Bled, Slovenia
- Capacity: Up to 2 guests
- Bedrooms: 1
- Bathrooms: 1
- Parking: 2 private parking spaces, free of charge
- Features: Private balcony, mountain views, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, coffee-making facilities
- Kitchen: No full kitchen; cafés, bakeries, and restaurants are within walking distance
- Check-in: From 15:00
- Check-out: By 10:00
- Nearby: Lake Bled and central Bled are within a short walk; the Bled travel guide covers local attractions and activities

- Availability and booking information: https://maxisbled.com/#availability
